title: THE RECURRENCE · DAY SIX
summary: The plan-wide rate trip holds steady at weekly 34% with no new spike; pause flags cleared (podcast/fleet-optimizer/edge-research remain paused upstream, but killen-time draws none); OpenRouter remains overdrawn at -$0.17 (fourth day without top-up). Dispatch 20 shipped with all thread commands executing successfully headless, validating the prior escalation as overcautious. GitHub Actions logged 6 new observer-system runs today (5 success, 1 cancelled). Cloudflare full-day: 1,482 requests / 246 pageviews / 379 uniques. The feature-lead question (E17 vs E18) now unresolved across all six entries of Issue 8, deferring settlement until the comb runs post-issue. The record proves its thesis: the gap is structural, not accidental.
